name: Val Town
title: val.town
shortDescription: Val Town is a platform designed for engineers to collaboratively write and deploy TypeScript applications. It simplifies the process of creating API endpoints and automations, making it ideal for developers looking to streamline their workflows. Users can schedule and publish content from databases to social platforms, implement passwordless authentication, and track online content with notifications.
pros: Integration with popular services like Slack and Discord
